newsitem.title: USA: ServiceMaster names Rooney vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: ServiceMaster names Rooney vice chairman.

text.p: ServiceMaster LP said Friday it named Phillip Rooney, former president and chief executive officer of WMX Technologies Inc, as vice chairman effective May 1.
Rooney, who will report to the chief executive officer, will be responsible for developing new business initiatives.
Rooney, 52, resigned on February 18 from his post at WMX after Soros Fund Management, a major shareholder, demanded his ouster.
WMX, in a proxy statement, said Rooney would be paid $2.5 million per year through 2002 as part of his severance package with the waste management company.
Rooney will continue to serve as a member of ServiceMaster's board of directors.
ServiceMaster provides a network of services to residential, healthcare, educational and commercial customers.
